# beam4pm_pro GCE Image Build

Packer template building a Google Compute Engine custom image for
beam4pm_pro: `debian-12` base, Docker installed, the
product container `ghcr.io/seanchatmangpt/beam4pm:latest` pre-pulled, and a systemd unit
(`beam4pm.service`) that runs it on port
8080 at boot.

Both `.pkr.hcl` files here are generated consequences of the consumer RDF
graph (`b4pi:PackerImage` facts) via `ggen sync run` -- edit the graph and
regenerate; never hand-edit these files.

## Files

| File | Source template | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `beam4pm-image.pkr.hcl` | `packer-beam4pm-image.pkr.hcl.tmpl` | `packer`/`source`/`build` blocks. Fact-driven provisioning content (the systemd unit body, the `docker pull` line, the provenance-facts write) stays inline here as HCL heredoc content. |
| `setup.sh` | `packer-setup.sh.tmpl` | Static OS-provisioning script (package install, Docker daemon enablement), uploaded to the build VM by its own `file` provisioner. Carries zero `b4pi:*` fact interpolation, so it renders byte-identically for any consumer's `b4pi:PackerImage` individual. |
| `variables.pkr.hcl` | `packer-variables.pkr.hcl.tmpl` | Variable defaults projected from the graph. |
| `README.md` | `packer-readme.md.tmpl` | This document. |

Packer provisioning is split across two files by what each provisioner
content depends on. The fully static half -- installing Docker and enabling
its daemon, with no per-consumer fact or build-time variable in it -- lives
in `setup.sh` and is uploaded verbatim by a `file` provisioner. The
fact-driven half -- the systemd unit (keyed on `b4pi:containerName` /
`b4pi:servicePort`), the `docker pull ${var.container_image}` line, and the
provenance-facts write -- stays inline inside `beam4pm-image.pkr.hcl`'s own
heredoc content, because Packer's `file` provisioner copies externally
sourced bytes verbatim and never HCL-interpolates `${var.*}` inside them:
anything needing a build-time `${var.container_image}` or a per-render
templated fact value has to stay where Tera and Packer both still evaluate
it.

## Build

Requires real GCP credentials (`gcloud auth application-default login`),
the Compute Engine API enabled, and image-create IAM. None of that is
exercised by the manufacturing pipeline -- local validation stops at
`packer validate`.

```bash
packer init  infra/gcp/packer
packer validate infra/gcp/packer
packer build -var "project_id=YOUR_PROJECT" infra/gcp/packer
```
